/**
 * @name Unsafe YAML deserialization
 * @description deserializing untrusted data using yaml.load can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-yaml-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember("load").getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe yaml.load call. Use safe_load instead."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe YAML deserialization using yaml.load without Loader=SafeLoader

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection
 * @description Checking for command injection vulnerabilities in subprocess or os.system calls.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(SystemCommandExecution c).getCommand()
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Checks for command injection vulnerabilities where user input is passed to system commands.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Log Injection
 * @description Detecting log injection vulnerabilities where external input is written to logs without sanitization.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @security-severity 5.0
 * @precision medium
 * @id custom/python/log-injection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-117
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources

module LogInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember(["debug", "info", "warning", "error", "critical", "log", "exception"]).getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module LogInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<LogInjectionConfig>;
import LogInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from LogInjectionFlow::PathNode source, LogInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where LogInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Log injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "external input"
findings.hypothesis: Unsanitized user input written to logs (Log Injection)
